preconditions.description: The number of tiles in the bag is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each tile has a number written on it, either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: output is a permutation of the input sequence
postconditions.description: The output must be a rearrangement of the input sequence of tiles.

postconditions.expression: maximize the number of prefix sums that are prime numbers
postconditions.description: The goal is to maximize the count of prime numbers among the prefix sums of the output sequence.
